mechanism: sigma-Reveal: inference-time selection of token-budgeted context from CLI observations
evidence_scope: For selective observation, we introduce σ-Reveal, an inference-time mechanism that selects token-budgeted context for the same CLI.
evidence_role: For credit assignment, we propose Action Advantage Assignment ( A3), a native agentic RL method that preserves the algorithmic complexity of standard agentic RL.
